description:
T-Rex Solutions is looking to select an AI Engineer to support our Internal Revenue Service (IRS) EDOS program. The overall mission of this program is to modernize the IRS legacy Tax processing systems and is critical to the overall modernization of the IRS to improve taxpayer experience, increase voluntary compliance, and reduce the IRS’s reliance on costly and unsustainable legacy technology. This role will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing robust solutions for a variety of programs and applications.

 The AI Engineer partners with client teams to architect, develop, and operationalize responsible AI systems—including RLHF instruction models, generative applications, and comprehensive guardrails—to align with ethical, performance, and business objectives. They drive the adoption of AI development standards and conduct rigorous evaluations of LLMs against industry benchmarks and custom metrics. This role involves selecting, building, and fine-tuning machine learning models using Python, Java, and open-source frameworks, applying advanced NLP and ML techniques to address complex language challenges.

 Embedding robust software engineering practices, the AI Engineer implements reproducible experiment tracking, version control workflows (Git), unit and integration testing, and CI/CD pipelines tailored for ML deployments. They leverage containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code to ensure scalable, maintainable systems, participate in peer code reviews, and document solutions for cross-team knowledge sharing. Collaborating with leadership and stakeholders, they identify AI opportunities, shape strategic roadmaps, and translate technical findings into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.

 Responsibilities: 

 
 Lead and implement the development and optimization of prompt engineering strategies

 Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks

 Develop AI applications using Python and cloud services

 Manage AI project delivery and support technical implementation

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions

 
 Requirements: 

 
 Bachelor's Degree and 7+ years of experience

 US Citizenship required

 Must possess an active IRS MBI Clearance and have current GFE

 Hands on experience with Azure OpenAI and AWS cloud services

 Proficient in Python AI application development

 Deep understanding of RAG frameworks and prompt engineering techniques

 Strong project management and delivery leadership skills

 Experience supporting complex AI/ML initiatives

 Demonstrated ability to translate technical concepts for diverse stakeholders

 Experience with the following:
 
 Machine learning model optimization

 Advanced prompt engineering techniques

 Cloud infrastructure management

 Agile project delivery methodologies.

 


 Excellent oral and written communication skills with client stakeholders at all organizational and technical levels

 
 Desired Skills: 

 
 Prompt Engineering

 Artificial Intelligence (AI)

 Large Language Models (LLMs)

 AWS GovCloud

 Python

 
 T-Rex Overview 

 Established in 1999, T-Rex Solutions, LLC is a proven mid-tier business providing data-centric mission services to the Federal government as it increasingly tries to secure and leverage the power of data. We design, integrate, secure, and deploy advanced technical solutions for our customers so they can efficiently fulfill their critical objectives. T-Rex offers both IT and professional services to numerous Federal agencies and is a leader in providing high quality and innovative solutions in the areas of Cloud and Infrastructure Services, Cyber Security, and Big Data Engineering.

 T-Rex is constantly seeking qualified people to join our growing team. We have built a broad client base through our devotion to delivering quality products and customer service, and to do that we need quality individuals. But more than that, we at T-Rex are committed to creating a culture that supports the development of every employee's personal and professional lives. T-Rex has made a commitment to maintain the status of an industry leader in compensation packages and benefits which includes competitive salaries, performance bonuses, training and educational reimbursement, Transamerica 401(k) and Cigna healthcare benefits.

 T-Rex is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit based factors.

 In compliance with pay transparency guidelines, the annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $152,000. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. T-Rex considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer.

 T-Rex offers a diverse and collaborative work environment, exciting opportunities for professional growth, and generous benefits, including: PTO available to use immediately upon joining (prorated based on start date), paid parental leave, individual and family health, vision, and dental benefits, annual budget for training, professional development and tuition reimbursement, and a 401(k) plan with company match fully vested after 60 days of employment among other benefits.
